## Core Question

What kinds of repeated structure appear across parrot vocal sequences, and what can those patterns tell us about how complexity evolves?

## Approach

This project compares vocal sequences across multiple parrot genera, using quantitative sequence analysis and modeling approaches to describe note repetition, transition structure, and larger-scale organization.

## Why It Matters

Parrots provide one of the clearest opportunities to study elaborate learned vocal behaviour outside humans. Comparative sequence analysis helps reveal which structural features are shared broadly and which are lineage-specific.

## Related Output

A recent collaborative preprint argues that note repetition may play a central role in the vocal sequences of diverse parrots.
